name: Routing & Pages
description: Next.js App Router route segments — the home/hero page plus the contact, projects and experience pages that compose components and read typed content data to render each URL.

name: Application Shell & Chrome
description: The persistent frame wrapped around every route: the root layout and page-transition template, plus global navigation, footer, theme context/toggle, scroll progress and the ambient backdrop and cursor glow effects.

name: Motion Primitives
description: Generic, content-agnostic Framer Motion wrappers under src/components/motion — reveal-on-scroll, magnetic hover, tilt cards and staggered split headlines — reused across pages and feature components.

name: Presentational Components
description: Portfolio-specific display widgets built on the motion primitives — the hero portrait, rotating greeting, GitHub contribution graph, experience timeline progress indicator and decorative wavy rule.

name: Content Data
description: Typed, statically-authored site content in src/content — the project catalogue and work-experience entries that stand in for a CMS or database in this static portfolio.

name: Shared Utilities
description: Dependency-free helpers in src/lib: the Tailwind class-merging utility and the scheduled light/dark theme calculation consumed by the theme provider.

name: Build & Styling Configuration
description: Project-level toolchain and design-token setup — Next.js, PostCSS, Tailwind and TypeScript configuration, the dependency manifest, generated Next type declarations, and the global stylesheet defining theme CSS variables.
